title: Server execution budget, doctor environment exit and B0134 precision
why: A long server job could not declare a larger step ceiling, the wall-clock ms warning was logged like an error, doctor reported an unresponsive test browser like a failing test, and B0134 rejected callbacks that run after the declaration they read.
changelog: raises its B0910 execution ceiling in its header
tries the tests a second time
B0134 no longer rejects a `watch` callback
